# Handoff — In-Between Space: Autogenerated Exterior Envelope, Dedicated Floor Decks, & Pixel Weather

**Date:** 2026-09-24  
**Status:** ACTIVE  
**Team:** Cross-functional Design Team (Exterior Architect, Floor Deck & Theming Specialist, Pixel Weather Engineer, Systems Integration Lead)  

---

## 1. What Changed

We designed and implemented the **In-Between Space** architecture for *One Roof*, establishing the physical boundary between the tower's cutaway interior and the outside world, eliminating see-through building gaps with dedicated themeable floor objects, and introducing stylized pixel rain and roof runoff.

### 1.1 Building Exterior Envelope (`BuildingExteriorPresenter`)
- **Autogenerated Facade Walls**: Dynamically generates structural cutaway section walls matching each floor's `CellBounds` (`MinX` and `MaxX`):
  - Left section wall ($T_{\text{wall}} = 0.36\text{m}$, $Z = 0.10\text{f}$) from ground to roof, with deep basalt foundation plinth, anodized weather cladding ($Z = -0.05\text{f}$), horizontal spandrel tie-plates ($Z = 0.08\text{f}$), and continuous drainage downspout pipe.
  - Right section wall for upper floors ($f \ge 1$), integrating with the ground-floor ($f = 0$) lobby public threshold, entrance architrave, and cantilevered canopy awning ($Z = 0.38\text{f}$) meeting the street apron.
- **Stepped Setback Terraces**: Automatically generates terrace roof slabs and safety guardrailings whenever lower floors extend beyond upper floors (e.g. ground slab expansion).
- **Capping Roof Structure**: Sits atop the highest floor ($Y_{\text{roof}} = Y_{\text{baseline}}(N-1) + 1.75\text{m}$):
  - Structural roof slab ($0.28\text{m}$ thickness), cornice overhang fascia lip, and dark gravel ballast deck.
  - Left and right parapet walls ($0.42\text{m}$ height) with beveled coping stones.
  - Rooftop mechanical fixtures: elevator penthouse machinery bulkhead with louvers over the shaft chute, dual-fan HVAC chiller unit, roof access hatch, and a lattice communications mast with a pulsating red/amber aviation warning beacon.
- **Outside Stage Bounds (`OutsideStageBounds`)**: Computes typed geometric bounds (`LeftExteriorZone`, `RightExteriorZone`, `RooftopZone`, `InteriorCutawayEnclosure`, and eave drainage scuppers) demarcating the outside world from the indoor cutaway.

### 1.2 Dedicated Floor Deck & Theming Subsystem (`FloorDeckView`, `FloorDeckPresenter`, `FloorTheme`, `FloorThemeCatalog`)
- **Elimination of the $0.27\text{m}$ See-Through Gap**:
  - Replaced empty gaps between room bottom ($y - 0.74\text{m}$) and the lower floor ceiling ($y - 1.01\text{m}$) with a dedicated, physical multi-layer floor deck.
  - Layer 1: Walking tread surface ($0.05\text{m}$, $Z = 0.05\text{f}$, `sortingOrder = -1`).
  - Layer 2: Structural core slab ($0.17\text{m}$, $Z = 0.08\text{f}$, `sortingOrder = -2`) in heavy concrete/conduit.
  - Layer 3: Ceiling soffit underside ($0.05\text{m}$, $Z = 0.12\text{f}$, `sortingOrder = -3`) facing the level below.
- **Elevator Shaft Opening**:
  - Automatically splits the deck into West and East wings around the vertical chute ($[-2.40\text{m}, -1.40\text{m}]$), bounded by safety threshold sill curbs.
- **Extensible Floor Theming**:
  - Strongly typed `FloorTheme` model holding surface, core, soffit, and sill colors/textures.
  - `FloorThemeCatalog` with 6 built-in themes:
    - `theme:concrete_slab`: Reinforced concrete (Default/Industrial)
    - `theme:hardwood_parquet`: Herringbone hardwood parquet (Residential)
    - `theme:tech_grid_tile`: Corporate tech tile (Offices/Commercial)
    - `theme:retro_checkerboard`: Diner retro checkerboard (Dining/Retail)
    - `theme:utility_grate`: Steel diamond grating (Utilities/Maintenance)
    - `theme:luxury_carpet`: Executive velvet carpet (Penthouses)
  - Dominant theme auto-resolution based on room content types, plus procedural pixel textures for 100% headless test resilience.

### 1.3 Outside Stage Pixel Rain & Roof Runoff VFX (`PixelRainPresenter`)
- **Single-Mesh Dynamic Procedural Buffer**:
  - Packs 384 rain drops, 64 roof drips, and 64 splash particles into a single preallocated mesh buffer (1 draw call, 0 steady-state GC allocations).
- **$O(1)$ Mathematical Dry-Interior Masking**:
  - Checks particle positions against `_floorBounds` bounding boxes. Rain falls strictly in the outside stage (sky, west air column, east street column); zero rain drops penetrate cutaway rooms or elevator shafts.
- **Roof Water Runoff & Drips**:
  - Detects exterior roof eaves and gutters; generates accelerating gravity runoff droplets ($g = 14\text{m/s}^2$) cascading into the outside world, creating pixel splashes upon impact with ledges or street level.
- **Day/Night Atmospheric Integration**:
  - Tints rain streaks from silvery daylight `RGBA(180, 220, 245, 175)` to deep night indigo `RGBA(85, 115, 155, 130)`, with golden amber glistening near street lamps.

### 1.4 Deep Presenter & Controller Wiring
- Integrated into `TowerPlayableController`:
  - `ExteriorPresenter` (`BuildingExteriorPresenter`)
  - `FloorDeckPresenter` (`FloorDeckPresenter`)
  - `RainPresenter` (`PixelRainPresenter`)
- Bound into lifecycle: `Initialize()`, `SyncPresenterGeometry()`, `RenderVisualSnapshot()`, and `ClearWorldGeometry()`.
- Zero steady-state GC allocations in the per-frame update loop.

### 1.5 URP Shader Compatibility & Magenta Artifact Remediation
- **Root Cause**: In Unity 6 URP 17.3, `Shader.Find("Universal Render Pipeline/Unlit")` returned null at runtime when not pre-warmed, causing presenters to fall back to `Shader.Find("Unlit/Color")` (Built-in Pipeline shader). In URP, Built-in shaders fail compilation and render as solid magenta (`#FF00FF`).
- **Remediation**:
  - Authored a dedicated, high-performance URP unlit shader [`OneRoofUnlit.shader`](file:///home/geisha/Vibecode/UnityAI/one-roof/Assets/OneRoof/Runtime/Presentation/Shaders/OneRoofUnlit.shader) with passes for `SRPDefaultUnlit`, `UniversalForward`, and `UniversalForwardOnly`, supporting `MaterialPropertyBlock` instancing (`_BaseColor`, `_Color`, and `_BaseMap`).
  - Authored default resource material asset [`OneRoofWorldMaterial.mat`](file:///home/geisha/Vibecode/UnityAI/one-roof/Assets/OneRoof/Runtime/Content/Resources/Materials/OneRoofWorldMaterial.mat).
  - Updated `CreateWorldMaterial()` and all presenters (`PixelRainPresenter`, `TowerAtmospherePresenter`, `NpcViewPool`, `InspectOutlinePresenter`, `PlacementGhostPresenter`, `UtilitiesNetworkLayerPresenter`, `VisualEffectsPresenter`) to prioritize `OneRoofWorldMaterial` and `OneRoof/Unlit`, completely eliminating all legacy `Unlit/Color` fallbacks across the codebase.
